requirement: Build/recore the radiator from the old J40/2H sample, preserving necks, cap, overflow, drain, mounts, and fan/shroud clearance
minimum_acceptance: Old sample controls final geometry; candidate core basis about 435 x 530-540 x 60-64 mm only if it matches the vehicle
evidence_required: Video/photo of old and new/recore radiator together; pressure/flow test result
fail_condition: Random model-name radiator; wrong necks/cap/drain/mounts; no pressure test

requirement: Support radiator from both sides on rubber-isolated lower pads/saddles and side retainers
minimum_acceptance: Radiator sits square with no tank twist, no hose tension, and no one-sided support dependency
evidence_required: Front and side dry-fit photos with rubber pads and both supports visible
fail_condition: Previous bad one-sided leg copied; radiator used as structural member

requirement: Fabricate two full-height front cooling-stack uprights
minimum_acceptance: 50 x 50 x 4 mm mild-steel angle preferred; 40 x 40 x 3-4 mm SHS/formed plate acceptable if packaging requires
evidence_required: Photos of material thickness, upright placement, and chassis/front support pickup
fail_condition: 2 mm angle, aluminium angle, twisted/pitted stock, unsupported single upright

requirement: Attach uprights through sound chassis/front support structure
minimum_acceptance: Bolt-through saddles with crush tubes/spacers preferred; weld only to cleaned sound metal after dry-fit approval
evidence_required: Close photos of saddle/bolt route or weld-prep area before coating
fail_condition: Weld to rusty/painted metal; clamp boxed section without spacer; hard mount to radiator tank/core

requirement: Fit R134a parallel-flow condenser ahead of radiator
minimum_acceptance: Target 14 x 22 in; 14 x 23 in accepted if clear width >=600 mm, clear height >=370 mm, thickness about 20-26 mm
evidence_required: Tape photos of condenser overall width/height/depth, port side, and installed position
fail_condition: Tube-fin/unknown condenser; too wide/tall/deep; bent/oily; no fitting proof

minimum_acceptance: Separate rubber-isolated tabs, 10-15 mm minimum radiator air gap, no fin loading
evidence_required: Side photo showing condenser-to-radiator air gap and tab mounts
fail_condition: Through-fin rods, zip ties, wire, or condenser hanging from radiator

requirement: Package and install slim 12V pusher fan if required by traffic/head-pressure behavior
minimum_acceptance: 12-14 in fan assembly with blade/shroud/mount feet; mounted to hoop/crossbar; airflow direction and current draw known
evidence_required: Fan part photos, depth measurement, current draw note, grille clearance photo/video
fail_condition: Motor-only part, puller-only fan, through-fin mounting, unknown current draw

requirement: Install new sealed R134a receiver-drier near condenser outlet
minimum_acceptance: Vertical mount, matched O-ring ports, capped until final assembly, pressure-switch port or separate switch block
evidence_required: Photo of sealed drier, port style, vertical clamp, flow direction
fail_condition: Open/unsealed drier; flare/O-ring mismatch; no pressure-switch provision

requirement: Protect compressor clutch with binary/trinary pressure switch
minimum_acceptance: Switch thread and logic matched; low/high pressure cutout verified before clutch operation
evidence_required: Continuity/electrical test note or video; switch wiring photo
fail_condition: Compressor can run with no charge or excessive pressure; unknown switch logic

requirement: Reuse existing Sanden-type compressor only after compatibility gate
minimum_acceptance: 12V clutch; pulley aligned; suction/discharge ports identified; R134a oil plan; shaft/port leak test passed
evidence_required: Compressor label/head/port photos; belt alignment photo; A/C shop leak/oil note
fail_condition: 24V compressor on 12V system; wrong pulley; shaft leak; unknown oil after contaminated system

requirement: Accept purchased slimline/under-dash A/C unit into the full system only after fit and function checks
minimum_acceptance: Case fits under J40 dash; drain routes outside; airflow seals across coil; TXV/fittings identified; leak test passed
evidence_required: All-side measurements, under-dash cardboard/mock-up photos, drain route photo, fitting/TXV photos, airflow/current notes
fail_condition: Bulky visible hang-on install forced; no drain route; unsealed airflow; fitting conflict; no leak test

requirement: Fabricate R134a barrier hoses after all component positions are locked
minimum_acceptance: Matched crimp fittings, HNBR O-rings, service ports, protected pass-throughs, no belt/fan/exhaust contact; route is compressor to condenser to drier to TXV/evaporator to compressor suction
evidence_required: Pre-crimp route photos; final crimp photos; nitrogen/vacuum leak-check note
fail_condition: Hydraulic/fuel hose; crimp before layout; hose rubs belt/fan/exhaust; wrong fitting standard

requirement: Wire A/C fan, clutch, and blower through protected circuits
minimum_acceptance: Fuse/relay sizing based on measured fan/clutch/blower current; pressure-switch logic included
evidence_required: Fuse/relay/wiring photo; current draw note; functional test video
fail_condition: Unfused feed, undersized wiring, no relay where required, pressure switch bypassed

requirement: All front-stack and under-dash A/C parts remain removable and serviceable
minimum_acceptance: Radiator, condenser, fan, drier, evaporator/filter/drain, and service ports accessible without cutting welded parts
evidence_required: Final installed photos with grille/bonnet/dash clearance and service points visible
fail_condition: Bonnet latch, grille, cap, drain, fan, belts, hose, evaporator, filter, or service access blocked

requirement: Validate coolant and A/C system before handoff
minimum_acceptance: Cooling pressure test, warm idle leak check, A/C vacuum hold, pressure protection, condenser fan behavior, drain test, airflow test, and running clearance pass
evidence_required: Pressure/vacuum test photos or video; warm running clearance video; condensate and airflow notes
fail_condition: Leaks, overheating/head-pressure issue, clutch not cutting out, fan not responding, condensate leak, weak airflow, unresolved contact/rub
